title: Hatsune Miku — Beyond That Door〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
I feel much better now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. Thank you for telling me about your battle with An and your recent training.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I can't believe that you haven't been able to notch a single win. They must be really good.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They are... It's been a solid reminder of just how incredible the people who helped make RAD WEEKEND happen were.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Also, the thing is...
During our walk, I thought I should ask...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Miku...
Would you mind practicing with me right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right now...? Here?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, please...
I want to become better and stronger so that we can actually surpass RAD WEEKEND!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, let's practice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: While we're at it, let's play the same freestyling game you've been playing at your training.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you, Miku! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She's got a chip on her shoulder now...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I guess her battle with An is the reason why.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She seemed to be her usual, cheerful self after it happened...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I guess things aren't that simple.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She must be feeling so anxious, stuck and frustrated.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (After all, she's grown to become a better singer in that neighborhood by experiencing her fair share of victories and defeats...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (However, she's now trying to use that bitterness to become even stronger.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (To become an even better musician.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That being said, I don't intend to lose...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, now it's my turn. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Your power and technique are always good, but the way you sang just now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's like you were trying to overwhelm me with your aura.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought a head-on battle would be what you need right now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Still... I lost again.
I have to find a way to win... To surpass them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Sorry, Miku...
But can we try doing that again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Kohane...
I understand how you feel, but you shouldn't push yourself so hard.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What matters most to you right now are the events you've been traveling to and your training at COL, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why don't we try singing together next?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. All this talk of winning and losing is going to just worsen your burden. So, why don't we just try singing freely?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I'll start us off.
You jump in whenever you feel like it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, let's begin.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I thought that a head-on battle was the right choice just now, but I may've been mistaken...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Because I'm not the one Kohane has to surpass.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I should help her grow and become able to sing her heart out.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You don't have to worry about winning against me. Just sing the way your heart tells you.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Because that's when you put on your best performances.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Now then...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I need to do my best to make up for showing off.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Kohane and the others are one step away from reaching the level of RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And I want to give them the push they need to get there.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (You can do it, Kohane.)
